TextEng: This elven ranger keeps a sharp eye on the bridge over the chasm. His body language expresses a nervous energy and expectation of an attack at any time.
This deep gnome, or svirfneblin, seems nervous and confused.
This halfling has a jolly, open look on his face; very different from the rangers in this area.
This massively-muscled behemoth stands watching the south road like a tower made of flesh.
This child looks at you with a curious gaze, seemingly unafraid.
This ranger looks, beaten, wounded and exhausted.
This ranger stands by the fire, surveying his wounded men and shaking his head with a bitter, twisted smile.
